headword: {春夏秋冬|しゅんかしゅうとう}
gloss: the four seasons; spring, summer, autumn, and winter

definitions.gloss: the four seasons; spring, summer, autumn, and winter
definitions.explanation: A literary and formal way to refer to all four seasons as a group. Used to express the full cycle of the year and seasonal changes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{春夏秋冬|しゅんかしゅうとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{春夏秋冬|しゅんかしゅうとう}、⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Each of the four seasons has its own pleasures.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{庭園|ていえん}→庭園：12452_teien⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{春夏秋冬|しゅんかしゅうとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|つう}じて→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せて→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: This garden offers beautiful scenery throughout all four seasons.

notes:
USAGE:
{春夏秋冬|しゅんかしゅうとう} is a four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) listing the seasons in order: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧ (spring), ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧ (summer), ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧ (autumn), ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧ (winter). The on'yomi reading gives it a literary, elevated tone.

This expression is often used in contexts emphasizing the beauty and distinctness of Japan's seasonal changes, a recurring theme in Japanese culture.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {春夏秋冬|しゅんかしゅうとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|つう}じて→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧ (throughout all four seasons)
- {春夏秋冬|しゅんかしゅうとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧ (enjoy all four seasons)
- {春夏秋冬|しゅんかしゅうとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{移|うつ}り{変|か}わり→移り変わり：13760_utsurikawari⟧ (the changing of the seasons)

The expression ⟦{四季|しき}→四季：11809_shiki⟧ (four seasons) is the more common everyday synonym. {春夏秋冬|しゅんかしゅうとう} sounds more poetic and is preferred in literary, travel, and cultural contexts.
